sections.heading: C2 — Confusables and KG hints
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Signals Signs and Markers

FACT_ID: sec05-R01 | anchor: A01
Steady red stops before turns that stay conditional, while flashing red stops fully before a safe unconditioned go [A01].
Why it matters: group signals; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec05-F01, sec05-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec05-R02 | anchor: A01
Steady yellow demands a safe stop or cautious clearing, flashing yellow only slower caution, and flashing yellow left arrows add oncoming-yield duty [A01].
Why it matters: group signals; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec05-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec05-R03 | anchor: A01
Steady green goes with intersection vigilance and yielding lefts, while green arrows beside red go carefully in the arrow's path after yielding [A01].
Why it matters: group signals; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec05-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec05-R04 | anchor: A02
Red orders, yellow warns, orange flags work zones, and brown guides recreation, matched by octagon stops, triangle yields, diamond warnings, and pennant no-pass notices [A02].
Why it matters: group sign-code; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec05-F04, sec05-F05 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec05-R05 | anchor: A03
For reverse curves, sharp turns and gradual curves, reduce speed, stay right and avoid passing. For a winding road, travel slowly and cautiously without passing [A03].
Why it matters: group warning-signs; difficulty low; prereq sec05-F04; confusables sec05-F06, sec05-F07 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec05-R06 | anchor: A04
Junction warnings cover T, Y, merges, and must-turns, while surface warnings cover gravel, dips, soft shoulders, and ice [A04].
Why it matters: group warning-signs; difficulty medium; prereq sec05-F06; confusables sec05-F08, sec05-F09 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec05-R07 | anchor: A06
Stop signs force full stops with yielding starts for every vehicle, while advisory speeds merely cap safe curve travel [A06].
Why it matters: group regulatory-signs; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec05-F13 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec05-R08 | anchor: A07
All-way stops run by arrival with right-side ties, protected green arrows stop oncoming yet still want caution, and center lanes serve slowing lefts while far-left lanes serve passing [A07].
Why it matters: group regulatory-signs; difficulty high; prereq sec05-F13; confusables sec05-F15 [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec05-R09 | anchor: A08
Advance rail signs warn hundreds of feet out, crossbucks mark every crossing with track counts, red crosses close lanes, and green arrows open them [A08].
Why it matters: group guide-signs; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec05-F16, sec05-F17 [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec05-R10 | anchor: A09
Broken lines permit safe passing, solid yellow forbids it, and rail stops land fifteen to fifty feet from the rails [A09].
Why it matters: group markings; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec05-F18 [A09].
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec05-R11 | anchor: A10
Crosswalks and stop lines fix where stops land, solid white discourages crossing, and double solid white bans it outright [A10].
Why it matters: group markings; difficulty medium; prereq sec05-F18; confusables sec05-F19 [A10].
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec05-R12 | anchor: A11
Work-zone traffic devices use orange as their basic color. A traffic violation in a construction zone carries double fines when workers are present [A11].
Why it matters: group work-zones; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec05-F20 [A11].
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec05-R13 | anchor: A12
Stripe slopes point the passing side, and flaggers demand in-lane stops with motionless waits for their signal [A12].
Why it matters: group work-zones; difficulty low; prereq sec05-F20; confusables sec05-F21 [A12].
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0042]
